title: Decide whether the closing-checkpoint retry exception admits a closing checkpoint the producer refused
outcome: engram_unsettled_closing_checkpoint_holds (src/engram_admission_retry.rs) admits an active grant whose newest checkpoint card is a Degraded turn_checkpoint naming the head. That includes an explicit producer refusal of the close (request_refusal: failure_class ProducerRefusal, remote_application Refused, engram_host_adapter.rs:4867-4882). The docs describe only an unsettled close (lost reply, missed deadline). Either exclude the refused cause, or document it deliberately, with a witness either way.
acceptance: A witness shows the chosen behaviour for a closing turn_checkpoint the producer explicitly refused, followed by a bind-backoff park: either the explicit hold (exclusion) or the scheduled retry that settles the grant before the head's evaluate (documented inclusion), and docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md states it.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
